footer: Unofficial, open-source tool for Task Bar Hero. Your save is processed locally in this tab and never uploaded.
crashTitle: TBH Companion web failed to render

home.title: TBH Companion
home.tagline: Browse the item catalog, chest drops, and Steam Market prices — then inspect your own save. Everything runs in your browser.
home.dropPrivacy: The file is decrypted and analyzed entirely in your browser. It is never uploaded, and nothing is sent anywhere.

one.title: Find your save
one.body: On Windows it is under the path shown below. The live file is named SaveFile_Live.es3.

two.title: Drop it here
two.body: Drag the file onto this page, or pick it with the button. It is read locally and never uploaded.

three.title: Explore
three.body: Open Inventory for your items, or jump straight into the catalog and market pages below — those need no save.

home.quickHint: These pages render real data with no save file at all.
home.quickLookupHint: Every obtainable item, its stats, and Steam Market prices.
home.quickChestsHint: Every obtainable chest and the stages it drops from.
home.quickTradingHint: Tradable items with their latest listed prices.

inventoryEmpty.title: Inventory comes from your save
inventoryEmpty.body: Drop a save file on the Home page, or choose one here to see your items.

trading.intro: Tradable items from the bundled catalog with their latest Steam Market listing price.
trading.empty: No tradable items in the catalog.
trading.filtersEmpty: No items match the current filters.

savePath.title: Where is my save file?
savePath.body: On Windows it is under {{path}} — look for {{file}}.

prices.warning: Prices are unavailable right now, so the catalog is shown without them. The snapshot refreshes automatically.

desktop.title: These features need the desktop app
desktop.body: A browser can't watch your save file, read the game's memory, or float a window over the game. The desktop app does all of it, stays read-only, and keeps your data on your PC.

liveXp.title: Live XP & gold rates
liveXp.body: Watches your save while you play and shows XP/hour, gold/hour, and per-hero rates.

liveMemory.title: Read-only live memory
liveMemory.body: Reads stage clears, chest drops, and DPS straight from the running game for second-accurate data, and streams real-time wish (offering) results.

overlay.title: Chest tracker & always-on-top overlay
overlay.body: Cooldown timers for every tracked route, plus a mini overlay that floats over the game.

pricing.title: Automatic Steam Market pricing
pricing.body: Prices your whole inventory in one pass and totals it after market fees.

extras.title: Loot history & auto-classify, wish history, notifications
extras.body: Tracks what dropped, auto-classifies loot, follows your wish results, and alerts you when a chest is ready.
